class Solution:
    def nextPermutation(self, nums: List[int]) -> None:
        if len(nums) <= 1:
            return
        i, j, k = len(nums) - 2, len(nums) - 1, len(nums) - 1

        # find: A[i]<A[j]
        while i >= 0 and nums[i] >= nums[j]:
            i -= 1
            j -= 1

        if i >= 0:  # 不是最后一个排列
            # find: A[i]<A[k]
            while nums[i] >= nums[k]:
                k -= 1
            # swap A[i], A[k]
            nums[i], nums[k] = nums[k], nums[i]

        # reverse A[j:end]
        i, j = j, len(nums) - 1
        while i < j:
            nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
            i += 1
            j -= 1
